areas.name: US Coast Guard VHF DSC (Rescue 21)
areas.text: DSC test calls to the US Coast Guard group identity 003669999 on VHF should be automatically acknowledged. Select Test Call in the radio's menu; never send a distress alert to test. Coverage is roughly out to 20 nm from the US coast.
